cards.name: Tithe
cards.flavor: Ten percent, every Sunday, forever. God's own subscription.
cards.notes: Leech Seed (the user, 2026-10-17): Leech 1 for 3 Days on target enemy creature: at each Dusk it takes 1 and you heal 1.
cards.picture: A collection plate on a very long pole reaching from a gilded pulpit all the way across the battlefield into an enemy creature's pocket, coins flowing back along it into a fat bishop's lap.

cards.name: Berserker
cards.flavor: Pain is just the body's way of asking for more.
cards.notes: Berserk: +3 Attack at half Health or less. The worse it gets, the better he does.
cards.picture: A bare-chested Norse warrior with a bear pelt over his head, arrows sticking out of him like a pincushion, grinning wider with each one, swinging an axe in each hand, foam on his beard.

cards.name: Tutankhamun
cards.flavor: Death shall come on swift wings to him who disturbs the peace of the king. Swift-ish.
cards.notes: Pharaoh's Curse (Pokémon's Perish Body): a creature that attacks it is Doomed 3, and so is the pharaoh (the Carnarvon curse: Mummy, the Hive Mind test creature, keeps its name). Three Days of growing dread for both.
cards.picture: A bandaged mummy sitting up in its sarcophagus pointing a bony finger at a tomb raider in a pith helmet, both of them with a little hourglass over their heads showing the same three grains of sand.

cards.name: Holy Pigeon
cards.flavor: The Holy Spirit, as depicted. Please do not feed it.
cards.notes: Leapfrog (the user, 2026-10-17: 'make also the holy pigeon'): it flies over creatures to an empty slot. Arrival: Bless 1 on every friendly creature: a ward against the next status.
cards.picture: A fat grey city pigeon with a golden halo and two tiny angel wings perched on a cathedral gargoyle, a beam of holy light on it, a crumb of communion wafer in its beak, a saint's statue below it freshly anointed.

cards.name: The Last Shall Be First
cards.flavor: And the first shall wait their turn, like everyone else.
cards.notes: Trend for 3 Days (Trick Room, Myth's flavour, after the verse): Rush Hour, the slowest act first.
cards.picture: The pearly gates with a velvet rope and a bouncer angel waving through a line of old beggars, cripples and a snail while a procession of kings and CEOs with golden tickets is held at the back.

cards.name: Novena
cards.flavor: Nine days of prayer. Delivery on the tenth.
cards.notes: Wish (the user, 2026-10-17): a Prayer on target friendly creature's slot for 2 Days: when they run out, at the end of the next Day, whoever stands in that slot heals 6. Help that arrives late, for whoever is still there to receive it.
cards.picture: A hospital bed with a bandaged creature in it, a GET WELL SOON balloon drifting in through the window two days late, and outside, a crowd of politicians with their hands clasped and eyes closed, each holding a phone showing the hashtag #thoughtsandprayers.

cards.name: Holy Ghost
cards.flavor: Thou canst not touch what thou canst not see. Thou canst, however, light a candle.
cards.notes: Wonder Guard (the user, 2026-10-17: 'would be better for holy'): Immaculate. Attacks and effects do nothing to it; only a status (Burn) hurts it, and with 1 Health any Burn is the end. Doomed and Destroy still take it.
cards.picture: A translucent white sheet-ghost with a golden halo and two round eye holes, hovering serenely in a church aisle while arrows and bullets pass straight through it and clatter on the floor behind, a dove on its head, and in the corner a single lit match it eyes with real fear.

cards.name: Taqiyya
cards.flavor: The smile is sincere. The rest is between me and God.
cards.notes: The user, 2026-10-16: a poisoned gift. Played on your side, it deploys for 2 Days; on arrival it goes over to the enemy, into the slot opposite, and whatever stands there is discarded. There it's a Turncoat: no summon can replace it and they can't order it to attack; each Dawn it attacks a random other creature of its new side, Reveals another (you see its plans) and takes 1 Attack off another. Low Health: they can knock it out easily (Friendly Fire, an effect).
cards.picture: A serene robed figure bowing slightly and offering an ornate gift box tied with a gold ribbon, both hands extended in welcome; on the wall behind, the box's shadow is a coiled snake.

cards.name: Omen Reading
cards.flavor: The entrails say Tuesday. The goat disagreed.
cards.notes: Myth's ritual: Sacrifice 1, then send for any card from your deck; it joins your next hand.
cards.picture: A robed augur reading the entrails of a goat on a stone altar by candlelight, squinting at a calendar pinned to the wall, an assistant taking notes.

cards.name: Memento Mori
cards.flavor: Remember that you will die. Preferably on schedule.
cards.notes: Mechanics test: Doomed on either side. It wipes other statuses and blocks new ones, gives +1 permanent Attack each Dawn (it stays on the card), then Last Rites strike the opposite slot even if the creature Cannot Act, and it dies for real.
cards.picture: A skull on an office desk beside an hourglass, and a wall calendar with three days crossed out in red.

cards.name: Martyr
cards.flavor: He died for your sins. Your sins are on backorder.
cards.notes: Mechanics test: its entry effect waits for Deployment Time; dooming itself makes a planned sacrifice that grows stronger; its OnDied effect fires when the sentence is carried out.
cards.picture: A long-haired, bearded Jesus-like figure in white robes, arms outstretched, a price sticker on his halo. An online-store banner beside him reads "Salvation: Add to Cart (ships in 3 days)".

cards.name: The Holy Grail
cards.flavor: Drink from it and live forever. Terms and conditions apply.
cards.notes: Mechanics test: Blessed 2. Each stack negates the next status that would land, friendly or not, Doomed included. Persistent, up to 3 stacks.
cards.picture: A gilded chalice on a velvet cushion behind museum glass. A queue of knights in dented armor stretches out the door, each holding a numbered ticket, and a gift shop by the exit sells plastic replicas at 3 for 2.

cards.name: Exorcism
cards.flavor: The power of Christ compels you. The invoice follows.
cards.notes: Mechanics test: Cleanse (statuses) on any creature. Blessed loses all its stacks. On a Doomed creature it's Heresy: the sentence passes to the weakest creature on its side, or is carried out if it's alone.
cards.picture: A priest in full vestments holding a crucifix over a teenager on a bed, whose smartphone floats above them, glowing red, demonic notification bubbles pouring out of it.

cards.name: Mummy
cards.flavor: Touch the tomb, get the curse. It was in the fine print.
cards.notes: Mechanics test: Hive Mind. A creature that attacks it gains Hive Mind, replacing its own ability.
cards.picture: A museum mummy shaking hands with a smiling tourist, its bandages unravelling and winding up the tourist's arm, a "Please Do Not Touch" sign knocked to the floor.

cards.name: Omniscient Space-Time Bending Bearded Wizard
cards.flavor: Works in mysterious ways. Mostly late.
cards.notes: Each Dawn, Blessed on a random friendly creature.
cards.picture: An old bearded man on a cloud in a bathrobe and slippers, lazily pointing a TV remote at a tiny spinning universe.

cards.name: Cultist
cards.flavor: The end is near. Brunch is at eleven.
cards.notes: Fodder: when it dies, every friendly creature gets +1 Attack for good. The first to go when a Sacrifice is paid.
cards.picture: A hooded cultist holding a THE END IS NEAR sign in one hand and a pumpkin spice latte in the other.

cards.name: Phoenix
cards.flavor: Dies, comes back, posts about it.
cards.notes: Revive: once per combat it rises again at the next Dawn.
cards.picture: A flaming bird rising from the smoking ashes of a burnt toaster, wings spread wide.

cards.name: Excess of Bread and Wine
cards.flavor: Turned water into wine. Then wine into a hangover.
cards.notes: Heals your creatures; one of them is Exhausted (the hangover).
cards.picture: The Last Supper as a frat party: the apostles playing beer pong along the long table while Jesus refills everyone's cups from a jug.

cards.name: Monkey Hand
cards.flavor: Your wish is granted. Read the fine print.
cards.notes: Draw 3, and a random friendly creature is Doomed.
cards.picture: A shriveled, mummified monkey's paw held up in a purple room, like the cursed paw of the old horror story: long knobbly grey-green fingers with pointed nails, a tuft of black fur at the wrist. Three fingers still up, one already curled into the palm: three wishes left.

cards.name: Sacrificial Ritual
cards.flavor: Somebody has to go. Ideally the intern.
cards.notes: Sacrifice 1: draw 3. The weakest goes, so a Cultist pays for it and leaves its blessing behind.
cards.picture: Hooded figures chanting around a chalk pentagram, offering a rubber chicken on the altar.

cards.name: Reincarnation
cards.flavor: Last life, a worm. This life, a good boy. Next life: depends how this one goes.
cards.notes: Rebirth (once per combat it survives death with 1 Health) and Grow 1: each life a little better.
cards.picture: The Buddhist wheel of rebirth glowing in a temple: a pink worm on the left, a happy brown dog on the right, a dashed arrow arching from the worm's life to the dog's, a lotus between them.

cards.name: Holy War
cards.flavor: God is on our side. He's on theirs too. He's very busy.
cards.notes: Myth's wrath: every enemy creature takes 2 damage; yours take 1 (holy wars have no bystanders).
cards.picture: Two armies of medieval knights charging each other across a field, both under identical banners with the same golden cross, a bewildered angel in the clouds above holding a scorecard.

cards.name: The Great Flood
cards.flavor: Forty days of rain. You were warned. Twice.
cards.notes: Prophecy 2: in two Days, every enemy creature takes 3 damage. They see it coming; you'd better be ready to float.
cards.picture: A wooden ark riding a huge wave, the animals two by two waving from the deck, while a line of enemy soldiers on a hilltop holds umbrellas as the water reaches their chins.

cards.name: Mox Nox
cards.flavor: Soon it will be night.
cards.notes: Prophecy 2: at the Dawn two Days on, the strongest enemy creature (picked then) is destroyed.
cards.picture: An old sundial in a ruined cloister at dusk, the shadow of its gnomon falling across the Latin words MOX NOX carved in the stone, a black candle burning beside it.

cards.name: Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch
cards.flavor: Count to three. Not four. Not two. Five is right out.
cards.notes: 5 damage to target enemy creature and 2 to the creatures beside it (the user, 2026-10-15).
cards.picture: A golden orb with a jewelled cross on top, its pin pulled, held up by a monk reading from an enormous book, three fingers raised, knights ducking behind him.

cards.name: Lance Of Longinus
cards.flavor: Pierced the side of a god. Your creature is not a problem.
cards.notes: 3 damage to target enemy creature.
cards.picture: An ancient iron spearhead on a long wooden shaft, glowing faintly, pinned through a spy's trench coat to a brick wall, the spy wriggling out of the sleeves.

cards.name: Necronomicon
cards.flavor: Bound in human skin. The reviews are mixed.
cards.notes: Destroy target enemy creature; your weakest creature is sacrificed to play it. Black magic always takes something. With a Phoenix Feather the same Day, the feathered creature pays (one offering, every rite), and still rises.
cards.picture: A heavy book bound in stitched leather with a screaming face on its cover, lying open on a stone altar, a hooded figure reading from it while a shadowy hand rises out of the pages.

cards.name: The Wicker Man
cards.flavor: For a good harvest. Nothing personal, Sergeant.
cards.notes: Sacrifice 1: every enemy creature takes 2 damage. The film's ending, as a sweeper.
cards.picture: A giant wicker figure burning on a cliff at sunset, villagers in animal masks dancing around it and singing, a small policeman in uniform visible inside its chest.

cards.name: Thoughts and Prayers
cards.flavor: Sent. Nothing else will be.
cards.notes: Blessed 1 on every friendly creature. A politician's answer: it changes nothing, except the next status.
cards.picture: A politician at a podium covered in microphones, eyes closed and hands pressed together in prayer, while behind him an aide quietly shreds a stack of papers labelled REFORM.

cards.name: Religious Instrumentalization
cards.flavor: Holding the book upside down. It's the gesture that counts.
cards.notes: Conversion: take control of target enemy creature with 2 Attack or less. It joins you, for good.
cards.picture: A politician in a suit posing for cameras in front of a church, holding a bible upside down over his head, while a confused small creature from the other side shuffles over to stand behind him.

cards.name: Deus Vult
cards.flavor: God wills it. God was not consulted.
cards.notes: Every friendly creature gets +2 Attack this Day.
cards.picture: A crusader in a bucket helmet and white tabard with a red cross shouting with a raised sword, a meme caption bar at the bottom of the picture.

cards.name: Curse Of Hubris
cards.flavor: Flew too close to the sun. Landed in the comments.
cards.notes: The strongest enemy creature gets -3 Attack, for as long as it's in play.
cards.picture: Icarus with melting wax wings falling past a mountain top, a crowd of Greek gods on a cloud filming him on their phones.

cards.name: Genesis
cards.flavor: Let there be light. And two more creatures.
cards.notes: Summon 2 creatures from your deck.
cards.picture: A huge bearded hand reaching out of the clouds and pointing at the ground, where two small creatures pop out of the earth blinking, a sun switching on above them like a lamp.

cards.name: The Lost Ark
cards.flavor: Don't look at it. Seriously, don't.
cards.notes: Every enemy creature takes 3 damage; yours close their eyes (Exhausted).
cards.picture: A golden chest with two winged angels on its lid, opened in a desert camp, ghostly light pouring out and melting the faces of enemy officers while an adventurer in a fedora keeps his eyes shut.

cards.name: Templar Knight
cards.flavor: Took a vow of poverty. Owns half of Europe.
cards.notes: When ready: Blessed 2 on itself, so the next two statuses aimed at it are wasted.
cards.picture: A knight in chainmail and a white mantle with a red cross, sword raised, standing in front of a medieval bank counter piled with gold coins and promissory notes.

cards.name: Zealot
cards.flavor: Will die for the cause. Will tell you about it first.
cards.notes: When ready: Doomed 3 on itself. It grows +1 Attack each Dawn, then its Last Rites strike and it dies for the cause.
cards.picture: A wild-eyed hermit in sackcloth with a long beard, waving a burning torch and a hand-painted REPENT sign on a busy city sidewalk.

cards.name: Vampire
cards.flavor: Doesn't drink. Just takes a little off the top. Every night.
cards.notes: Strength Sap (the user, 2026-10-15), kept fair: each Dawn the enemy creature facing it loses 1 Attack while it stays in play, and the Vampire heals 1. Only the one in front of it, so stepping out of its lane stops it; Allergic to Light, the Reveal it fears.
cards.picture: A pale aristocrat in a cape at a blood-donation clinic, sipping from a sleeping gym bro's arm through a bendy straw, the bro's bicep visibly deflating like a balloon.

cards.name: Living Dead
cards.flavor: Died on Friday. Back on Monday. Still not answering emails.
cards.notes: Revive: once per combat it rises again at the next Dawn.
cards.picture: A grey zombie in a business suit climbing out of a cemetery grave with its briefcase, a sunrise behind the tombstones.

cards.name: The Chosen One
cards.flavor: This time he brought backup.
cards.notes: Spray and Pray: its attacks also hit the creatures beside its target. The second coming, armed.
cards.picture: Jesus in white robes and sandals with a halo, firing two golden submachine guns akimbo, doves scattering; nothing behind him but the temple light, he steals the show.

cards.name: Killer Rabbit of Caerbannog
cards.flavor: Look at the bones!
cards.notes: A harmless-looking bunny that strikes first and hard.
cards.picture: A small fluffy white rabbit sitting innocently in front of a cave mouth littered with bones and dented helmets, a tiny drop of red on its whiskers, knights fleeing in the distance.

cards.name: Black Knight
cards.flavor: 'Tis but a scratch.
cards.notes: Unbothered: enemy effects can't lower its stats. Arms off, legs off: it's only a flesh wound.
cards.picture: A knight in black armor standing defiantly at a forest bridge with no arms left, sword on the ground, shouting at a bemused king who rides an invisible horse to the sound of coconuts.

cards.name: Buddy Christ
cards.flavor: Winks. Points. Forgives.
cards.notes: Each Dawn, every friendly creature heals 1.
cards.picture: A smiling plastic Jesus statue winking and giving a big thumbs up and a finger point, on a church lawn next to a sign reading CATHOLICISM: WOW!

cards.name: Pope
cards.flavor: Infallible. Bulletproof glass, just in case.
cards.notes: Each Dawn, Blessed 1 on your strongest creature.
cards.picture: The Pope waving from a glass-domed popemobile, sprinkling holy water from a garden hose over a crowd of creatures.

cards.name: The Lobster Professor
cards.flavor: Clean your room, bucko. Then buy the seminar.
cards.notes: Each Dawn, your strongest creature gets +1 Attack for as long as it's in play: the dominance hierarchy, as preached.
cards.picture: A gaunt professor in a three-piece suit lecturing tearfully at a lectern, pointing at a projected slide of a lobster sitting on a throne, the audience taking notes, a messy bedroom visible through a door behind him.

cards.name: Amen
cards.flavor: And so it is. Go in peace. Now.
cards.notes: Amen (the user, 2026-10-16): it ends the Day when it resolves, with the spells: every other action still in the queue, both sides', is discarded (their cards go to the discard pile), so no attack lands that Day. Single Use: it burns out.
cards.picture: A choir of robed monks in a stone chapel snapping a giant hymn book shut with a thunderclap, every candle in the room blowing out at once, a single wisp of smoke curling up from each.

cards.name: Pyramids
cards.flavor: Built by aliens, apparently. Or by paid workers on beer rations.
cards.notes: Pyramids (the user, 2026-10-16): a monument, not a fighter. 0 Attack, 10 Health, two Days to build. Safe Space: each Dawn it and the friendly creatures beside it gain Bless, the pharaoh's eternal protection. Myth holds the status quo.
cards.picture: The three pyramids of Giza at golden sunset, the biggest one's capstone glowing with a holy light that rains down on two tiny knights standing beside it, a bored camel in the foreground.

cards.name: Horsemen Of Apocalypse
cards.flavor: Four riders. One group chat.
cards.notes: When ready (the end was foretold): every enemy creature takes 2 damage.
cards.picture: Four horsemen galloping out of storm clouds, War, Famine, Pestilence and Death, one of them checking a smartphone map, a lightning bolt behind.

cards.name: God's Grace
cards.flavor: Not today, my child. Thursday, maybe.
cards.notes: Die Another Day for the player, holy: Grace until the Dusk of the next Day, your Health can hit 0 and you don't lose. At that Dusk, still at 0 or less, you do. If both players fall to 0 at once, the one in Grace wins.
cards.picture: A battered knight at 0 Health, a red health bar empty above his head, held upright by a beam of light from parted clouds, two cherubs propping him up by the armpits, a choir of angels singing behind.

cards.name: Phoenix Feather
cards.flavor: It burns. It rises. It invoices you for the ashes.
cards.notes: Target friendly creature is sacrificed (its Last Will happens; a Blessing can't stop it) and rises again at the Dawn 3 Days later, ready, full Health. Three days, as the scripture says. Myth's loophole: its offering pays a Necronomicon's Sacrifice the same Day, one death for both.
cards.picture: Only the feather, watercolour on paper: red at the quill through orange to a yellow heart, its barbs licking out like flames, a glowing eye near the top, the tip burning out lilac, sparks all round.

cards.name: The Omen
cards.flavor: He's not a bad kid. He's the Antichrist.
cards.notes: When ready: Doomed 2 on the strongest enemy creature.
cards.picture: A small boy in a neat suit on a tricycle in a long mansion hallway, staring straight at the viewer, a black dog sitting beside him and a 666 birthmark peeking from his hairline.

cards.name: Grim Reaper
cards.flavor: Not today. Probably.
cards.notes: A body that kills on arrival: 3 damage to the creature facing it. Myth's creatures were slow and soft; this one isn't.
cards.picture: The Grim Reaper in his black hood waiting in a hospital corridor, checking his watch, a number ticket in his bony hand, a sign above him reading NOW SERVING 42.

cards.name: Blessing in Disguise
cards.flavor: It looked like a disaster. It was a disaster. But a blessed one.
cards.notes: Myth holds the board (a status quo faction): every friendly creature heals 3 and gains Bless 1.
cards.picture: The farmer's story: his horse has run away and the neighbours cry WHAT BAD LUCK!; the old farmer in a straw hat shrugs, MAYBE, a soft halo over him, while over the hill his horse is already coming back with a herd of wild horses.

cards.name: Die by the Sword
cards.flavor: Live by it, too, if you can.
cards.notes: Removal with a reward: 4 damage to target creature, and if it dies, you heal 3.
cards.picture: A knight run through by his own sword which bounced back off a mirror, a smug monk holding the mirror.

cards.name: Mithril
cards.flavor: Light as a feather. Hard as dragon scales. Worth a Shire.
cards.notes: Armor 4 and Bless 1 on target creature: Myth's knights, made to last.
cards.picture: A silver chain-mail shirt glittering on a velvet cushion in a dwarven forge, a tiny hobbit trying it on and a dragon peering in through the window.

cards.name: Here Be Dragons
cards.flavor: The map ends here. The dragon doesn't.
cards.notes: A big body: Arrival: 1 damage to every enemy creature. The edge of the old maps; its art is an ASCII dragon.
cards.picture: An old parchment sea map ending in a ragged edge, beyond it a big dragon drawn in green ASCII characters on a black terminal screen, breathing fire made of # signs.

cards.name: Gracias Jesús
cards.flavor: He brought the food in from the fields. You're welcome.
cards.notes: You heal 3 and draw 2 next Day: the meme of Jesus carrying the harvest in.
cards.picture: Jesus in a straw hat carrying two big baskets of vegetables in from the fields at sunset, a family at the farmhouse table clapping.

cards.name: Heretic
cards.flavor: Said the Earth was round. Got the stake. Said it louder.
cards.notes: Martyrdom: while Doomed, everything it deals is doubled. Its Arrival Dooms it 3 Days: three Days of double hits, growing each Dawn, then it burns. Doomed finally has an owner who wants it.
cards.picture: A heretic tied to a stake on a pile of firewood, laughing, swinging a broken chain at the inquisitors as the first flames catch, a placard reading 'The Earth is round' nailed above him.

cards.name: Ambrosia
cards.flavor: Food of the gods. Gluten-free, apparently.
cards.notes: Ripening: heal 2 and +1 Attack to target creature, 1 more of each for each Dawn it's kept in your hand (up to heal 5 and +4). Myth's patience.
cards.picture: A golden bowl of glowing honey on an Olympus banquet table, Zeus in sunglasses dipping a finger in, the jar's label reading 'Organic, Artisanal, Divine'.

cards.name: Publicly Funded Faith Schools
cards.flavor: Taxpayers fund the prayers. God funds nothing.
cards.notes: Policy: Bless 1 on a random friendly creature, and again at each Dawn, for the rest of the combat. Blessed (it wards off the next status or destroy) finally piles up.
cards.picture: A classroom of kids in uniforms praying over their exam papers instead of writing, a nun at the front under a 'Funded by your taxes' banner hung over the crucifix.
